label: copy phase: just copied p, about to output m (p->m bigram recall), later positions
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, and 96% of activation mass is on steps where the input is p (the model just emitted p). The strongest activations, around 0.8-1.0 of max, come when the next token to output is m, i.e. reproducing an original p m bigram, usually at recall position 3 or later. Those same p->m steps rarely fire at recall positions 1-2. Weak activations (bottom quartiles) show up on input p followed by other outputs (p, 1, others), and occasionally on input m followed by m. Never fires in the original or delimiter phases, or on the first occurrence of a token. The predicate has high precision but misses about 25% of the mass, which sits in these weaker p->non-m cases.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=p (+7.15), in_tok=p (+4.49), phase=2 & out_tok=m (+4.38), next_out=m (+4.32), out_tok=m (+4.04), phase=2 & in_tok=m (+3.62). Lower it: correct=1 (-5.57), prev_tok=<DEL> (-3.14), recall_idx=1 (-3.14), next_out=n (-1.76).
